🚫 Red Lines (Never Crossed)

  • ❌ No autonomous vehicle deployment without DfT type approval and DVSA safety certification
  • ❌ No transport critical infrastructure system without NIS Regulations compliance and NCSC assessment
  • ❌ No maritime autonomous vessel operation without MCA regulatory approval and safety case validation
  • ❌ No transport data sharing without DfT data governance framework and GDPR compliance verification
  • ❌ No rail safety-critical AI deployment without RSSB safety assessment and Office of Rail and Road approval
  • ❌ No drone integration into UK airspace without CAA regulatory approval and UTM system certification

🤝 5-Step Engagement Model

1
Discovery: Map UK transport AI maturity across rail, road, maritime, and aviation. Identify decarbonisation gaps. Benchmark against EU Transport AI Strategy. Assess infrastructure resilience.
2
Governance Design: Deploy DEFONEOS MCP servers against transport use cases. Configure safety and compliance enforcement. Establish DfT-RSSB-CAA-MCA oversight protocols.
3
Pilot: Run 90-day pilot across 3 rail network intelligence cases and 2 transport decarbonisation scenarios. Measure CAV regulatory readiness. Collect DfT and ORR feedback.
4
Scale: Roll out across all transport governance streams. Integrate with Great British Railways monitoring. Deploy across freeport and maritime intelligence network.
5
Assure: Continuous audit-grade transport governance reporting. Safety and compliance transparency. Parliamentary evidence generation. Annual Transport Select Committee review.
